label: Guardian relation
summary: Makes the given character the guardian of the character this runs on.
details: Writing it as a plain value (`= scope:guardian`) sets the relation with no reason. The block form also takes a reason, which needs a matching `_corresponding` text for the other side. Vanilla mostly gives a plain character, often `root`, run on a child, so the child's guardian is that character.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The other character in the relation.

fields.name: reason
fields.text: Key of the reason text shown for the relation. A second text named like it plus `_corresponding` shows the reason on the target's side, with the two characters swapped.

fields.name: copy_reason
fields.text: Copies the reason from another relation that already exists between the two.

fields.name: province
fields.text: A province tied to the reason.

fields.name: involved_character
fields.text: A third character tied to the reason.

label: Religious head title
summary: Makes the given title the head title of the faith.
details: Runs on a faith. Vanilla gives it a title, for example `title:k_papal_state` or a title saved earlier in the script.

label: Reserved gold maximum
summary: Sets the most gold the AI keeps in its reserved budget, which is also the amount it aims for.
details: The reserved budget is filled before the war chest budget. Gold already in the budget is not adjusted to the new maximum. Works on a character.

label: Reserved treasury maximum
summary: Sets the most treasury the AI keeps in its reserved budget, which is also the amount it aims for.
details: The reserved budget is filled before the war chest budget. What is already in the budget is not adjusted to the new maximum. Works on a character.

label: Rite enabled
summary: Turns a rite on or off.
details: A disabled rite is hidden in the interface and left out of the `available_rites` lists. Use `yes` to enable and `no` to disable.

label: Rite name
summary: Changes the name, description and follower names of an existing rite.
details: Each part takes a localization key or a dynamic description. Vanilla does not use this effect.

fields.text: The rite's name.

fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

fields.values: a localization key or dynamic description

label: Ruler objective decision
summary: Makes the given decision the character's ruler objective.
details: If the decision supports it, the game gives extra advice for it. Vanilla uses it once, with `unify_region_decision`. The input lists no scope for it; the game's example runs it on a character.

label: Same ethnicity as
summary: Gives the character the same ethnicity as the given character.
details: The character this runs on changes; the given character is only copied from.

label: Secret owner
summary: Makes the given character the owner of the secret.
details: Runs on a secret.

label: Sexuality
summary: Sets the character's sexuality.
details: Vanilla uses `heterosexual`, `homosexual`, `bisexual` and `asexual`.

label: Artifact decays
summary: Sets whether the artifact wears out over time.
details: `yes` lets it decay, `no` stops it. Runs on an artifact. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Situation center province
summary: Sets the province a situation is centered on.
details: The game uses it to place the situation's pins on the map. A script can read it back with the `situation_center_province` link. Vanilla gives the title province of a county.

label: Skip pursuit
summary: Makes a battle side skip the pursuit phase if it would lose.
details: That side then takes no extra casualties from pursuit. `no` undoes it and is the default. Runs on a combat side.

label: Special character
summary: Sets the faction's special character.
details: Runs on a faction. Vanilla gives it a character such as the peasant leader or the faction leader. The game does not say what the special character is used for.

label: Special guest
summary: Makes the given character the special guest of a chosen type at the activity, replacing the one there.
details: If the character is not attending, they are invited, possibly using a slot reserved for invites by effects. The effect gives an error if the activity has no such guest type. Vanilla does not use it.

fields.name: type
fields.text: The kind of special guest to set.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character who becomes the special guest.

label: Special title
summary: Sets the faction's special title.
details: Runs on a faction. Vanilla gives it a title such as a top liege's primary title. The game does not say what the special title is used for.

label: State rite
summary: Sets the state rite of a title.
details: Meant for a title whose holder has the `state_faith` government rule. Vanilla gives it a rite, such as a faith's main rite.
